The opposition BJP in Bihar today said the Nitish Kumar govt in the state is short on numbers and is not in a position to sustain voting on any Bill in the Assembly. PATNA: The opposition BJP in Bihar today said the Nitish Kumar-government in the state is short on numbers and is not in a position to sustain voting on any Bill in the Assembly. "As per the letter of support given to the Governor, Nitish Kumar government enjoyed the backing of 118 MLAs of JD(U) including the Speaker and four Independents, taking the tally to 122 in the 238-member House," senior party leader Sushil Kumar Modi told reporters here. "The Nitish Kumar government is short of numbers and cannot sustain voting on any Bill in the state Legislature," Modi, who is the Leader of Opposition in the state Legislative Council said.
